title: HorrorFace
description: Horror face, enemy and biom. Its like horror
body:
Overview
HorrorFace is a terrifying Minecraft horror mod designed to turn your world into a living nightmare. This mod introduces a horrifying 3D creature that stalks the world, hunting players with relentless AI. Once it catches your scent or spots you in the dark, it will never stop chasing you. Your only options are to run, hide, and pray you can survive the night.

If you are looking to turn Minecraft into a true survival horror experience where you are never truly safe, this mod is for you.

Features
Custom 3D Animated Mob: Features a uniquely designed, terrifying 3D model with custom animations built to look unsettling and jump-scare players.

Relentless AI Hunting: The creature uses advanced tracking logic. Once it locks eyes on you, it initiates a permanent chase sequence that will test your parkour and survival skills.

Atmospheric Horror Face: Includes terrifying visual cues and custom facial textures designed to maximize the scare factor during unexpected encounters.

True Hardcore Survival: Changes the pacing of standard Minecraft survival, forcing you to utilize stealth, blocking lines of sight, and quick thinking to stay alive.

Installation & Compatibility
Mod Loader: Forge

Minecraft Version: 1.20.1
